    • getLine

      ITooltipLine getLine(int index)
      Returns the line on this index.

      Note: position dependant, you can't access head tooltip in appendBody. To access all tooltip, use IEventListener.onHandleTooltip(ITooltip, ICommonAccessor, IPluginConfig).
